chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the recurring verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, emphasizing the cognitive and spiritual obligation to recognize Allah's favors. The repetition underscores the magnitude of blessings, serving as a reminder that denial leads to spiritual ingratitude, while acknowledgment fosters gratitude and submission.
